text:
nina: Heads-up — vendor-hyperlane just bumped H100 EU lead times from 8d to ~14d due to Port A congestion + depot backlog. This will affect Dedicated EU capacity for our launch.

vendor-hyperlane: Confirmed. We can do a split: 20 units air (ETA 3d), 20 units ocean (ETA 12-14d). Air expedite is +$3,000/unit. If you sign an amendment we can include 2 spares per 100 units at no extra shipping cost and pre-print RMA pickup labels in-box. Depot burn-in fail rate observed ~0.5%.

maya: @vendor-hyperlane please attach an updated ETA matrix, serial manifest, and depot acceptance photo checklist. Need the RMA label spec too so depot can do immediate pickup if failures seen.

vendor-hyperlane: Will push manifest+photos by EOD. RMA labels follow our template (pickup code + depot id).

sam: Quick back-of-envelope on cost: air 20 units * $3k = $60k. Alternative: transfer 10 from APAC (shipping+customs ~ $10k). So delta ~ $50k but meets timeline.

```
air_cost = 20*3000 = 60000
transfer_cost = 10000
delta = 50000
```

sam: Is 3 days critical vs 12?

liam: For EU feature launch we need 30 extra GPUs by D+7. Current EU slack = 12. If we take 20 air we'll hit 32 (>30). If we go ocean only, we miss launch.

ops-nyc: We have 6 slack in us-east but transit+customs to EU ~9d minimum. Not useful for D+7.

nina: Prioritize launch. @procurement-bot open PO amendment & flag finance for one-off expedite. Include spare line-items and RMA in-box notes.

procurement-bot: PO 98765_amendment created -> awaiting approval. Tags: @finance, procurement-team.

vendor-hyperlane: Also note: some depots flagged that they require photos within 24h of receipt for warranty acceptance. Recommend adding SLA into amendment: Depot photos within 24h, serial manifest CSV on delivery, RMA label included in-box.

maya: Agreed. Add SLA clause and specify CSV columns: serial, model, shipped_ts, depot_id, photo_md5.

sam: Approve air for 20 units + spares per vendor offer, contingent on finance sign-off.

finance: One-off expedite approved under code 4102. Please route invoice and updated cost breakdown.

nina: Vendor, send final amended invoice + manifest ASAP. We'll confirm once procurement-bot shows vendor acceptance.

vendor-hyperlane: Final invoice + manifest sent (attached). Shipping plan: airwaybill A12345 for 20 air (3d), ocean BL67890 for 20 (12-14d). Included 2 spare units per 100 and printed RMA labels taped in each crate. Depot photo procedure attached. :thumbsup:

maya: Received. ops, please prep depot for 24h photo turnaround and RMA pickup readiness.

ops-nyc: Noted. Will coordinate with EU ops team. Confirm depot contact + pickup window.

nina: Closing the loop — procurement-bot, mark PO amended and vendor confirmed. We'll log this thread for post-mortem if any RMA burn-in >0.5%.

procurement-bot: PO 98765_amendment -> vendor confirmed -> invoice routed to finance. Thread archived for 30d.

sam: thanks everyone. Keep RMA metrics handy so we can evaluate spare policy efficacy after this wave.
